integrity: Proof uses published strict-Jacobian premise and explicit real-root Rouché argument; standalone finite checker is auxiliary.
scientific_limitations: The inverse estimate is local for full-dimensional ellipsoids. Constants depend on the reference semiaxis multiset and deteriorate near axis-cluster mergers. Known ellipsoid intrinsic-volume formula and the independently established nonsingular-Jacobian lemma are essential stated premises; this result provides sharp multiplicity-indexed recovery rates and constructions. Center and orientation are not identifiable. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp multiplicity-stratified Hölder stability of ellipsoid intrinsic-volume recovery
